sentences.display: Decades after Thomas, an American filmmaker, Nicholas Clapp, read his account and set out to find Ubar.

sentences.display: He brought together scientists from NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory, among them Ronald Blom and Charles Elachi, with the archaeologist Juris Zarins, the explorer Ranulph Fiennes, and George Hedges.
